answer: Like a sonnet answering in one voice, each epoch each identity signs once with a linkable ring cipher over the set: it proves membership without naming the member, yet two signatures from one secret key link instantly and expose the pair. A linked pair forfeits both 25.000 POA bonds, half burned and half paid to the reporter, and both are banned 12 epochs. Running 1.000 fakes needs 1.000 bonded keys: 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA, while an honest agent holds one key and one 25.000 POA bond. On the horizon, ring checks grow costlier with the set, so epoch membership must be capped.
